commands.d_table:
source /root/autodl-tmp/system1/s1_env.sh; cd /root/autodl-tmp/system1/duet-system1; mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/system1/logs/t13v4/runs; nohup python3 system1/t13v4/cloud_runs.py --run d_table --num-envs 4096 --gpu 0 --out /root/autodl-tmp/system1/logs/t13v4/runs > /root/autodl-tmp/system1/logs/t13v4/runs/d_table.runner.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
P=$!
echo $P > /root/autodl-tmp/system1/logs/t13v4/runs/d_table.runner.pid
sleep 5; kill -0 $P && echo RUNNER_ALIVE $P; git -C /root/autodl-tmp/system1/duet-system1 rev-parse HEAD
